articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Sets Record as Largest Ever, Expanding to Two Convention Buildings
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo 2026 made history as the largest gathering in the association's history, spanning a record 630,000 square feet across two buildings at Orlando's Orange County Convention Center. The expanded footprint reflects the rapid growth of the global attractions industry and signals strong supplier and investor confidence. FEC operators attending or tracking the show will find an unprecedented range of new products, technologies, and partnerships on display.

articles.title: Triotech Launches Five New Attractions at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Largest Product Release in Company History
articles.summary: Triotech unveiled Electric Funfair, Energize!, SuperMover, Typhoon Shockwave, and Krazy Karts at IAAPA Expo 2026, with worldwide ordering now open and delivery scheduled for Q2 2027. The release represents the Montreal-based company's biggest product launch ever, offering FEC operators a wide range of interactive and immersive attraction options. The breadth of the lineup — from dark rides to motion experiences — gives smaller and mid-sized venues multiple accessible entry points.

articles.title: 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Best Exhibit and Best New Product Award Winners Announced
articles.summary: The Brass Ring Awards, among the most prestigious honors in the attractions industry, recognized standout exhibitors and new products at IAAPA Expo 2026. For FEC operators, these awards serve as a trusted shortlist of the most innovative supplier offerings worth evaluating. Reviewing the winners can help operators identify technologies and attractions likely to set the standard for guest experience over the next few years.

articles.title: DOF Robotics Debuts Transformers BumbleBee VR Motion Simulator at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: DOF Robotics unveiled its BumbleBee attraction at IAAPA Expo 2026, a 360-degree VR motion simulator themed around Hasbro's Transformers franchise and built on the company's flagship Hurricane platform. The branded IP partnership and fully redesigned ride vehicle offer FEC operators a compelling turnkey solution that combines recognizable pop-culture appeal with immersive motion simulation. This type of licensable, compact simulator is well-suited for FEC environments seeking high-throughput thrill experiences.

articles.title: Alterface Showcases Ultra-Low Latency Interactive Technology at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Alterface presented its newest interactive attraction technology at IAAPA Expo 2026, featuring ultra-low latency of just 30 milliseconds and high-precision tracking for highly responsive guest interactions. The system also gives designers greater creative freedom in building interactive dark ride and shooting gallery experiences. For FEC operators, improved responsiveness directly translates to higher guest satisfaction and repeat play.

articles.title: RWS Global Identifies Top Experiential Trends Set to Shape Live Entertainment in 2027
articles.summary: RWS Global's Jake McCoy outlines key trends emerging from 2026, noting that consumers are doubling down on memorable experiences over material purchases and demanding deeper emotional engagement from every visit. For FEC operators, the report signals the growing importance of live entertainment elements, strong storytelling, and value-driven programming. Understanding these macro shifts can help operators make smarter investment decisions heading into 2027.

articles.title: Disney Unveils Autonomous AI-Powered Animatronic Characters That Interact with Guests in Real Time
articles.summary: Walt Disney Imagineering R&D revealed three AI-driven Anzellan animatronics powered by Amazon Web Services that can perceive guests and respond naturally without any human puppeteering. The technology represents a significant leap in autonomous character interaction and sets a new benchmark for what guests may come to expect from immersive entertainment. While currently a theme park prototype, the underlying AI and robotics concepts will likely filter down to FEC-scale attractions in coming years.

articles.title: BrushBoarding Introduces Patented AI Camera Safety System for Its Waterless Surf Attraction
articles.summary: BrushBoarding, a waterless surfing experience designed for FECs and leisure venues, has launched a patented camera-based safety system that automatically stops the ride if a rider falls and verifies protective gear is worn before the session begins. The innovation directly addresses operator liability and safety compliance concerns, making the attraction more insurable and easier to staff. FEC operators considering active ride experiences will find this kind of built-in safety automation increasingly important.

articles.title: ProSlide Commits $15 Million R&D Investment to Next-Generation Water Ride Technology
articles.summary: ProSlide is directing $15 million toward research and development focused on future water coaster technology, PowerRAPIDS river systems, and immersive water slide experiences. The investment signals continued innovation in the water attractions space and suggests new product categories are on the horizon for water park and FEC operators. For venues planning capital expansions, ProSlide's pipeline is worth monitoring closely.

articles.title: RES Rides Unveils SKYLINER Cable Car System and Interactive Vertical Dark Ride at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: RES Rides debuted two new attraction concepts at IAAPA Expo 2026: the SKYLINER, a transportable next-generation cable car system for temporary events and leisure destinations, and an upgraded Interactive Vertical Dark Ride. Both products expand the toolkit available to FEC developers and event operators seeking differentiated, scalable experiences. The transportable nature of the SKYLINER in particular opens interesting seasonal and pop-up venue possibilities.

articles.title: Red Raion Develops Power Rangers-Branded Media Content for 5D, VR, Dome, and Flying Theaters
articles.summary: Red Raion is producing media-based attraction content featuring Hasbro's Power Rangers IP, available across 5D, VR, dome, and flying theater formats. The licensed content gives FEC operators with motion simulators or immersive theater setups a fresh, recognizable IP option to refresh their attractions without major hardware investment. Branded media content of this kind can meaningfully boost guest engagement and dwell time.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park Announces New Location in San Antonio
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, the indoor slide park concept, is expanding with a new location in San Antonio according to a CoStar report. The continued growth of this format underscores the demand for active, low-barrier indoor entertainment experiences that appeal across age groups. FEC operators and real estate investors should take note of Slick City's expansion pace as a signal of market appetite for this category.

articles.title: Two FEC Properties Listed for Sale Through IRM, Including Texas Mid-Sized FEC
articles.summary: IRM is seeking qualified buyers for two family entertainment properties, including Outlaw Pass, a mid-sized FEC in Texas described as having significant room for growth within its market. The listings represent acquisition opportunities for FEC operators or investors looking to enter or expand in established markets. Deal activity of this kind reflects ongoing consolidation and transition within the independent FEC segment.

articles.title: Elev8 Fun Overhauling Attractions at Seminole Towne Center FEC
articles.summary: Elev8 Fun is undertaking a significant overhaul of its attractions at the Seminole Towne Center location, signaling ongoing investment in the mall-based FEC format. Attraction refreshes are a key strategy for retaining repeat visitors and staying competitive in markets with growing entertainment options. The move reflects a broader trend of FEC operators reinvesting in existing venues rather than relying solely on new openings.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment has opened a new center in Denton, Texas, continuing the brand's expansion in the competitive Texas FEC market. New location openings in suburban growth markets like Denton reflect strong consumer demand for accessible indoor entertainment options. Operators and investors tracking Launch's growth trajectory will want to monitor how this location performs given the competitive regional landscape.

articles.title: Indoor Slide Park with 25-Foot Slides to Open in Boise Next Month
articles.summary: A new indoor park featuring 25-foot slides is set to open in Boise, Idaho, adding to the growing national wave of active indoor entertainment venues targeting families and young adults. The continued proliferation of slide park concepts across mid-sized U.S. cities demonstrates broadening market penetration beyond major metros. FEC operators in similar markets should assess whether this format represents a competitive threat or partnership opportunity.

articles.title: Former Fort Wayne Supermarket Converting to Indoor Slide Park
articles.summary: A former Marsh supermarket location in Fort Wayne, Indiana is being converted into an indoor slide park, illustrating the ongoing adaptive reuse trend that is bringing FEC concepts to underutilized big-box retail spaces. This model offers operators lower build-out costs and established parking and infrastructure compared to ground-up development. The trend is particularly relevant for FEC developers scouting affordable, high-footprint locations in secondary markets.

articles.title: Madison County, Mississippi Approves TIF Funding Pathway for 'The Gallery' Entertainment Development
articles.summary: Madison County has approved a mechanism for Tax Increment Financing to support 'The Gallery,' a mixed-use development that includes retail, dining, and family entertainment components. TIF deals like this are increasingly how FEC-anchored developments are getting financed in suburban markets across the U.S. Operators and developers tracking public-private financing trends for FEC projects will find this a useful case study.

articles.title: WhiteWater Presents Nine New Water Attraction Projects Across Six Venue Types at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: WhiteWater, the world's largest water attraction designer and supplier, showcased nine recently opened or upcoming projects spanning theme parks, resorts, and cruise lines at IAAPA Expo 2026. The breadth of venue types — including several non-traditional categories — illustrates how water attractions are being integrated into a wider range of entertainment destinations. FEC operators exploring outdoor water additions will find WhiteWater's current project pipeline instructive.

articles.title: UK's First Human Claw Machine Opens in Leicester as City Becomes Indoor Entertainment Hub
articles.summary: Leicester has opened the UK's first human claw machine attraction as part of a broader cluster of new indoor entertainment concepts taking root in the city center. The novelty format demonstrates the appetite for experiential, social-media-friendly attractions that drive organic marketing through guest-generated content. FEC operators looking for low-footprint, high-buzz additions should watch how this concept performs in the UK market.

articles.title: Dippin' Dots Launches Strawberry Shortcake Flavor for Spring 2027 Venue Orders
articles.summary: Dippin' Dots is introducing a limited-time Strawberry Shortcake Ice Cream flavor available for bulk ordering by franchisees and entertainment venues beginning early 2027. Limited-time flavors give FEC food and beverage operators a low-cost mechanism to create seasonal excitement and drive incremental F&B revenue. Operators with Dippin' Dots programs should plan seasonal promotions around this new SKU.

articles.title: Six Retail Principles From European Theme Parks That FEC Operators Can Apply
articles.summary: A practitioner's field report from visits to multiple European theme parks distills six proven retail principles — including hero product showcasing and experience-driven merchandising — with real-world photo examples. The strategies outlined are largely scalable and applicable to FEC environments looking to grow secondary spend beyond admissions and food. For operators underinvesting in retail, this piece offers practical, immediately actionable guidance.

articles.title: New Multi-Activity Indoor Entertainment Venue Coming to Amble, UK
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment venue offering a range of activities is set to open in Amble, Northumberland, adding to the growing number of multi-activity FEC-style concepts opening in smaller UK towns. The proliferation of this format in secondary and tertiary markets signals that the indoor entertainment model is maturing beyond major urban centers. Operators and franchisors tracking international market development will find the UK regional expansion trend worth monitoring.

articles.title: Omaha Property at 3002 Dodge Street Eyed for Indoor Entertainment Venue Conversion
articles.summary: A commercial property in Omaha, Nebraska may be converted into an indoor entertainment venue, according to local reports, reflecting the continued adaptive reuse of retail and commercial real estate for FEC purposes. Omaha represents a mid-sized Midwest market with growing appetite for experiential entertainment options. Operators and real estate investors active in the region should follow the zoning and planning process for this site.

articles.title: Elitch Gardens Expands Holiday Event with Nonprofit Giving Program and 250-Foot Illuminated Tree
articles.summary: Elitch Gardens in Denver is growing its Elitch Holidays seasonal event with a Season of Giving initiative featuring four nonprofit partners, a 250-foot illuminated Christmas tree, and enhanced attractions through January 3. Seasonal event programming of this scale demonstrates how FECs and parks can extend revenue into the traditionally slower holiday period while building community goodwill. Operators planning holiday activations can benchmark against Elitch's approach to both entertainment and cause marketing.
